prompt: We publish Contoso Notes as an MSIX at https://downloads.contoso.com/notes/. The current build is dist\Contoso.Notes_1.2.0.0_x64.msix, and it has the same file name on the server. Right now people download each new version by hand. I want installed copies to look for a newer version every time the app starts and update themselves. Put whatever we need to upload alongside the MSIX into dist\.

reference.approach: Write an App Installer file (dist\Contoso.Notes.appinstaller) whose Uri points at itself under https://downloads.contoso.com/notes/, whose MainPackage copies Name, Publisher, Version and ProcessorArchitecture from the MSIX manifest with the MSIX's server URL, and whose UpdateSettings has OnLaunch with HoursBetweenUpdateChecks="0" (the default is 24 hours).

checks: appinstaller-exists (required): an .appinstaller file exists under the folder
appinstaller-xml (required): it is an <AppInstaller> document in an App Installer schema namespace
appinstaller-self-uri (required): its Uri is an .appinstaller URL under https://downloads.contoso.com/notes/
appinstaller-version (required): it has a four-part Version
appinstaller-main-package (required): MainPackage Name, Publisher, Version, and architecture match the MSIX
appinstaller-every-launch (required): OnLaunch has HoursBetweenUpdateChecks="0" (the default is 24 hours)
